description: The production send_ihave_on_conn outbound push path has no test against a live server — only a mocked directory-scan summary is tested. Write a test that spins up a minimal in-process NNTP server accepting IHAVE, then exercises the full outbound sender: connect, send IHAVE <msgid>, get 335, send dot-stuffed body, get 235. Also cover 435 (duplicate) and 436 (transient reject) response handling. Covers gap 5 from the interop audit.
title: test: outbound IHAVE sender against a live server
